subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass capabilities be exposed through public plugin SDK-facing types, or kept entirely internal to core restart plumbing?
rationale: The branch uses bypass flags to preserve pre-drain work, but the affected types live on SDK-facing surfaces where third-party plugins could depend on or misuse them without an explicit maintainer contract.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Move enqueueInternal/allowDuringGatewayDrain behind core-owned runtime helpers so plugins cannot call the bypass directly while restart flush code still can.

options.title: Approve Public Contract
options.body: Treat the bypass as a documented plugin SDK contract, add docs/baseline/export updates, and define when plugins may use it.

options.title: Pause PR
options.body: Leave this PR blocked until a broader restart-recovery design decides the admission model together with persistent queue recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
recommendation.body: Move enqueueInternal/allowDuringGatewayDrain behind core-owned runtime helpers so plugins cannot call the bypass directly while restart flush code still can.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available recent history across the affected followup queue, gateway run-loop, and plugin SDK boundary surfaces.
